evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a failure in legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration for wallets with watch-only transactions and no private keys. According to issue #36483, pre-commit validation required mapWallet to be empty prematurely, and aborting threw std::bad_function_call on an empty callback. Migration correctness is explicitly prioritized in the wallet category as an essential path for legacy wallet users.
